candidateDescription: A green-and-yellow armored dragon with purple spinal frills, a red eye, clawed limbs, and a scaly belly running and crouching across four run frames plus one crouch frame.
observations: The sprite is clearly a dragon — scaly green body, armored yellow belly, clawed feet, purple dorsal spines, and a reptilian head with a red eye; the requested species is immediately recognizable.

Deliberate dark-green outlines enclose every body part; the belly has highlight/shading contrast from the darker scales, the spines are individually rendered in purple, and the red eye with a white glint provides clear facial detail matching Coco's level of finish.

In the actual game-scene screenshot the dragon reads cleanly against the dark blue/grey night background; the yellow belly and green body provide strong contrast, and the silhouette is distinct and unambiguous at play scale.
The crouch frame shows the dragon flattened low to the ground with limbs tucked, spines visible but lowered, matching the same low-profile crouching silhouette convention Coco uses.
